verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Bulk Import flow in the desktop app with migration guides. Notion content can be imported as Markdown + CSV with type mapping reviewed in Bulk Import (capacities-docs-25, capacities-docs-60), and Markdown/Obsidian-style vaults can be mapped to object types via folders or YAML (capacities-docs-39, capacities-docs-61). Evernote is not imported natively: the user must convert ENEX exports to Markdown + media themselves (capacities-docs-62). Missing for 10: native Evernote import without user-side conversion, any Roam import path, explicit evidence that internal links and attachments are preserved, independent or hands-on corroboration.
